bands.read: the mixed pool beats the all-Qwen pool by more than 2x the seed floor: caption rotation is buying captioner diversity, not caption count
tie with the all-Qwen pool: an MF caption substitutes for a Qwen caption inside a rotation at no cost, even though MF alone is worse than Qwen alone
mixing MF into the rotation measurably hurts; the weaker captioner is not laundered by rotation

decision_rule.metric: MusicCaps 5521 / MeanFlow 25 / CFG 0 / seed 42 / NoMask / full precision / --no_q, clap_score
decision_rule.reporting_rule: the four AES metrics are reported alongside CLAP against the same 2x-floor rule; CLAP is primary only because it is the metric the comparator table is built on
decision_rule.seed_floor_source: CFG0 training-seed floors as recorded in mf_dedup_quarter_contract.json; margins under 2x a floor are reported as ties, never as wins

known_caveat: The third slot differs between the two controls (slot2 at quarter, slot3 at full). 034 licenses treating slot identity as noise, but it is an assumption, not a measurement made inside this arm.
mf_dedup unique caption rate is 0.9845 vs slot0's 1.0000, so pool position 2 carries slightly less distinct text than positions 0 and 1.
S1 400k = 12.72 epochs, so rotation coverage is effectively complete and the quarter-scale coverage caveat does not apply.
hypothesis.prior: 034 showed that which Qwen slots you rotate over is inside the seed floor on all five metrics, so all-Qwen rotation is rotating over near-interchangeable text. paired59k measured the captioner-only delta at CLAP +0.0073 for Qwen with all four AES metrics inside the floor, and MF alone loses to Qwen alone at full (0.2078 vs 0.2149). The naive prediction is therefore that mixing MF in lands at or below the all-Qwen pool; beating it would mean the rotation is buying captioner diversity, not caption count.
hypothesis.question: Does a true-random caption rotation gain anything when one of the three captions comes from a different captioner, rather than from the same captioner's other slots?
